inventory_label: Data management and financial safety in one place.
reference_status: Owner-approved Utilities dropdown with six selected entries and separate Backup/Restore is the applicable navigation reference. Do not recreate the older eight-card hub merely to match inventory.

findings.classification: Legacy hub diverges from the approved navigation structure
findings.current_behavior: The retained /utilities Web route shows eight cards including Audit History, Period Locks and Backup & Recovery. The approved Utilities dropdown contains six selected entries and Backup/Restore is separate. The current main menu no longer links the generic hub.
findings.required_correction: Explicitly retire/redirect the legacy hub or align its role with the canonical navigation. Preserve the owner-selected six-item dropdown and separate backup group; do not reintroduce rejected or unrequested menu entries.
findings.evidence: Actual SSR showed eight hub cards while buildAccountNavigation returned six Utilities entries. Source inspection establishes lack of a direct generic hub menu entry; live bookmark reachability was not exercised.

findings.classification: Hub cards do not honor destination read permissions
findings.current_behavior: Root requires ACCOUNT_REPORTS and filters cards only with admin flags. A Project Manager can enter the root but is shown Import (ACCOUNT_ACCOUNTS denied) and Data Verification (ACCOUNT_SETTINGS denied). An Accountant is also shown Verification despite denied Settings permission.
findings.required_correction: Use shared destination capability filtering and consistent permission-derived links, without broadening read/write authorization to make a dead link work. Reuse the canonical navigation policy if the hub is retained.
findings.evidence: Actual hub SSR with synthetic Project Manager/Accountant actors and direct canUsePermission evaluation. Destination headers enforce their separate permissions by source review. No unauthorized live read or mutation was tested.

shared_findings.impact: Exact native /utilities root has no dedicated route and falls through to NativeDestinationNotice. Keep the owner-approved menu structure rather than treating this as an instruction to expose Audit History.
Generic import/export destinations retain Inventory/item-gate policy inconsistencies; not re-counted as a new A117 finding.

verified_existing_controls: Explicitly admin-tagged Backup, Financial Year and Period Locks cards were hidden from the Project Manager SSR fixture.
Root read still requires ACCOUNT_REPORTS. Destination authorization is not bypassed by displaying a link.
Canonical menu tests still preserve six Utilities entries and separate four-option Backup/Restore.

verification.scope: Source/SSR/pure permissions only; no live deployment, browser or native tap test.

next_page.expected_behavior_from_inventory: Normal Account UI can only advance a lock. Closed years cannot be reopened.
